desc:
🟢 Collect rare slimes, earn money while you're away, and STEAL from other players' bases!

🌈 Find rare and secret slime variants, some with 1-in-a-million odds!
⚔️ Sneak past guards, raid other bases and carry their slimes home
🛡️ Upgrade your base and protect your cages from thieves
🔁 Rebirth for SlimeBlings and permanent boosts
🛠️ Buy gear to knock back, slow down and troll other players

👍 Like the game and join the group for new slimes, codes and updates!

🎵 Music: mp3_slayer

Trust no one. 👀
